name: best-of-n
description: Build N candidates in parallel on different cheap capable models, have a frontier reviewer compare them, then the captain picks the winner.

stages.title: Candidate {{i}} of {{n}}: {{goal}}
stages.prompt:
Implement this goal: {{goal}}
You are candidate {{i}} of {{n}} built independently; do your own best version. Commit your work on the current branch with a clear message.

stages.title: Compare the candidates
stages.prompt:
Several candidates built the same goal independently (branches and commits under 'Inputs from finished work'). Goal: {{goal}}
Compare them on correctness, scope, code quality and risk. Read the diffs, do not edit. Recommend one by task id and say why in a few lines.
